name: aggregate
syntax: aggregate ( layer , aggregate , expression [, filter ][, concatenator:='' ][, order_by ])
description: Returns an aggregate value calculated using features from another layer.

name: array_agg
description: Returns an array of aggregated values from a field or expression.

name: collect
description: Returns the multipart geometry of aggregated geometries from an expression

name: concatenate
syntax: concatenate ( expression [, group_by ][, filter ][, concatenator:='' ][, order_by ])
description: Returns all aggregated strings from a field or expression joined by a delimiter.

name: concatenate_unique
syntax: concatenate_unique ( expression [, group_by ][, filter ][, concatenator:='' ][, order_by ])
description: Returns all unique strings from a field or expression joined by a delimiter.

name: count
description: Returns the count of matching features.

name: count_distinct
description: Returns the count of distinct values.

name: count_missing
description: Returns the count of missing (NULL) values.

name: iqr
description: Returns the calculated inter quartile range from a field or expression.

name: majority
description: Returns the aggregate majority of values (most commonly occurring value) from a field or expression.

name: max_length
description: Returns the maximum length of strings from a field or expression.

name: maximum
description: Returns the aggregate maximum value from a field or expression.

name: mean
description: Returns the aggregate mean value from a field or expression.

name: median
description: Returns the aggregate median value from a field or expression.

name: min_length
description: Returns the minimum length of strings from a field or expression.

name: minimum
description: Returns the aggregate minimum value from a field or expression.

name: minority
description: Returns the aggregate minority of values (least occurring value) from a field or expression.

name: q1
description: Returns the calculated first quartile from a field or expression.

name: q3
description: Returns the calculated third quartile from a field or expression.

name: range
description: Returns the aggregate range of values (maximum - minimum) from a field or expression.

name: relation_aggregate
syntax: relation_aggregate ( relation , aggregate , expression [, concatenator:='' ][, order_by ])
description: Returns an aggregate value calculated using all matching child features from a layer relation.

name: stdev
description: Returns the aggregate standard deviation value from a field or expression.

name: sum
description: Returns the aggregate summed value from a field or expression.

name: array
description: Returns an array containing all the values passed as parameter.

name: array_all
description: Returns TRUE if an array contains all the values of a second array.

name: array_append
description: Returns an array with the given value added at the end.

name: array_cat
description: Returns an array containing all the given arrays concatenated.

name: array_contains
description: Returns TRUE if an array contains the given value.

name: array_count
description: Counts the number of occurrences of a given value in an array.

name: array_distinct
description: Returns an array containing distinct values of the given array.

name: array_filter
description: Returns an array with only the items for which the expression evaluates to true.

name: array_find
description: Returns the lowest index (0 for the first one) of a value within an array. Returns -1 if the value is not found.

name: array_first
description: Returns the first value of an array.

name: array_foreach
description: Returns an array with the given expression evaluated on each item.

name: array_get
description: Returns the Nth value (0 for the first one) or the last -Nth value (-1 for the last one) of an array.

name: array_insert
description: Returns an array with the given value added at the given position.

name: array_intersect
description: Returns TRUE if at least one element of array1 exists in array2.

name: array_last
description: Returns the last value of an array.

name: array_length
description: Returns the number of elements of an array.

name: array_majority
description: Returns the most common values in an array.

name: array_max
description: Returns the maximum value of an array.

name: array_mean
description: Returns the mean of arithmetic values in an array. Non numeric values in the array are ignored.

name: array_median
description: Returns the median of arithmetic values in an array. Non arithmetic values in the array are ignored.

name: array_min
description: Returns the minimum value of an array.

name: array_minority
description: Returns the less common values in an array.

name: array_prepend
description: Returns an array with the given value added at the beginning.

name: array_prioritize
description: Returns an array sorted using the ordering specified in another array. Values which are present in the first array but are missing from the second array will be added to the end of the result.

name: array_remove_all
description: Returns an array with all the entries of the given value removed.

name: array_remove_at
description: Returns an array with the item at the given index removed. Supports positive (0 for the first element) and negative (the last -Nth value, -1 for the last element) index.

name: array_replace
description: Returns an array with the supplied value, array, or map of values replaced.

name: array_reverse
description: Returns the given array with array values in reversed order.

name: array_slice
description: Returns a portion of the array. The slice is defined by the start_pos and end_pos arguments.

name: array_sort
description: Returns the provided array with its elements sorted.

name: array_sum
description: Returns the sum of arithmetic values in an array. Non numeric values in the array are ignored.

name: array_to_string
description: Concatenates array elements into a string separated by a delimiter and using optional string for empty values.

name: generate_series
description: Creates an array containing a sequence of numbers.

name: geometries_to_array
description: Splits a geometry into simpler geometries in an array.

name: regexp_matches
description: Returns an array of all strings captured by capturing groups, in the order the groups themselves appear in the supplied regular expression against a string.

name: string_to_array
description: Splits string into an array using supplied delimiter and optional string for empty values.

name: crs_from_text
description: Creates a coordinate reference system from a string definition. The string can represent an authority ID, a WKT definition, or a PROJ string definition of the CRS.

name: crs_to_authid
description: Returns the authority ID string for a coordinate reference system.

name: color_cmyk
description: Returns a string representation of a color based on its cyan, magenta, yellow and black components

name: color_cmyka
syntax: color_cmyka ( cyan , magenta , yellow , black , alpha )
description: Returns a string representation of a color based on its cyan, magenta, yellow, black and alpha (transparency) components

name: color_cmykf
syntax: color_cmykf ( cyan , magenta , yellow , black [, alpha:=1.0 ])
description: Returns a color object based on its cyan, magenta, yellow, black and alpha components.

name: color_grayscale_average
description: Applies a grayscale filter to a color and returns it. Returned type is the same as color argument, i.e. a color string representation or a color object.

name: color_hsl
description: Returns a string representation of a color based on its hue, saturation, and lightness attributes.

name: color_hsla
description: Returns a string representation of a color based on its hue, saturation, lightness and alpha (transparency) attributes

name: color_hslf
description: Returns a color object based on its hue, saturation, and lightness attributes.

name: color_hsv
description: Returns a string representation of a color based on its hue, saturation, and value attributes.

name: color_hsva
description: Returns a string representation of a color based on its hue, saturation, value and alpha (transparency) attributes.

name: color_hsvf
description: Returns a color object based on its hue, saturation, and value attributes.

name: color_mix
description: Returns a color mixing the red, green, blue, and alpha values of two provided colors based on a given ratio. Returned type is the same as color arguments, i.e. a color string representation or a color object.

name: color_mix_rgb
description: Returns a string representing a color mixing the red, green, blue, and alpha values of two provided colors based on a given ratio.

name: color_part
description: Returns a specific component from a color string or color object, e.g., the red component or alpha component.

name: color_rgb
description: Returns a string representation of a color based on its red, green, and blue components.

name: color_rgba
description: Returns a string representation of a color based on its red, green, blue, and alpha (transparency) components.

name: color_rgbf
description: Returns a color object based on its red, green, blue and alpha components.

name: create_ramp
description: Returns a gradient ramp from a map of color strings and steps.

name: darker
description: Returns a darker (or lighter) color. Returned type is the same as color arguments, i.e. a color string representation or a color object.

name: lighter
description: Returns a lighter (or darker) color. Returned type is the same as color arguments, i.e. a color string representation or a color object.

name: project_color
description: Returns a color from the project's color scheme.

name: project_color_object
description: Returns a color from the project's color scheme. Contrary to project_color which returns a color string representation, project_color_object returns a color object.

name: ramp_color
description: Returns a string representing a color from a color ramp.

name: ramp_color_object
description: Returns a color object from a color ramp. Contrary to ramp_color which returns a color string representation, ramp_color_object returns a color object.

name: set_color_part
description: Sets a specific color component for a color string or a color object, e.g., the red component or alpha component.

name: coalesce
description: Returns the first non-NULL value from the expression list. This function can take any number of arguments.

name: if
description: Tests a condition and returns a different result depending on the conditional check.

name: nullif
description: Returns a NULL value if value1 equals value2; otherwise it returns value1. This can be used to conditionally substitute values with NULL.

name: regexp_match
description: Return the first matching position matching a regular expression within an unicode string, or 0 if the substring is not found.

name: try
description: Tries an expression and returns its value if error-free. If the expression returns an error, an alternative value will be returned when provided otherwise the function will return NULL.

name: extract_degrees
description: Extracts the integer number of degrees from a decimal degrees value. The minutes and seconds components are ignored. The extracted degrees values will be truncated towards zero (not rounded).

name: extract_minutes
description: Extracts the integer number of minutes from a decimal degrees value. The degrees and seconds components are ignored. The extracted minutes values will be truncated towards zero (not rounded), and will always be a positive value.

name: extract_seconds
description: Extracts the decimal number of seconds from a decimal degrees value. The degrees and minutes components are ignored. The extracted seconds value will always be a positive value.

name: from_base64
description: Decodes a string in the Base64 encoding into a binary value.

name: hash
description: Creates a hash from a string with a given method. One byte (8 bits) is represented with two hex ''digits'', so 'md4' (16 bytes) produces a 16 * 2 = 32 character long hex string and 'keccak_512' (64 bytes) produces a 64 * 2 = 128 character long hex string.

name: md5
description: Creates a md5 hash from a string.

name: sha256
description: Creates a sha256 hash from a string.

name: to_base64
description: Encodes a binary value into a string, using the Base64 encoding.

name: to_bool
description: Converts a given value to a boolean. The function will return false if the value is NULL, an empty string, an empty list, or 0.

name: to_date
description: Converts a string into a date object. An optional format string can be provided to parse the string; see QDate::fromString or the documentation of the format_date function for additional documentation on the format. By default the current QGIS user locale is used.

name: to_datetime
description: Converts a string into a datetime object. An optional format string can be provided to parse the string; see QDate::fromString , QTime::fromString or the documentation of the format_date function for additional documentation on the format. By default the current QGIS user locale is used.

name: to_decimal
description: Converts a degree, minute, second coordinate to its decimal equivalent.

name: to_dm
description: Converts a coordinate to degree, minute.

name: to_dms
description: Converts a coordinate to degree, minute, second.

name: to_int
description: Converts a string to integer number. If a value cannot be converted to integer the expression is invalid (e.g '123asd' is invalid).

name: to_interval
description: Converts a string to an interval type. Can be used to take days, hours, month, etc of a date.

name: to_real
description: Converts a string to a real number. If a value cannot be converted to real the expression is invalid (e.g '123.56asd' is invalid). Numbers are rounded after saving changes if the precision is smaller than the result of the conversion.

name: to_string
description: Converts a number to string. The conversion is not locale-aware, see 'format_number' for a locale-aware alternative.

name: to_time
description: Converts a string into a time object. An optional format string can be provided to parse the string; see QTime::fromString for additional documentation on the format.

name: age
description: Returns the difference between two dates or datetimes. The difference is returned as an Interval and needs to be used with one of the following functions in order to extract useful information: year month week day hour minute second

name: convert_timezone
description: Converts a datetime object to a different timezone.

name: datetime_from_epoch
description: Returns a datetime whose date and time are the number of milliseconds, msecs, that have passed since 1970-01-01T00:00:00.000, Coordinated Universal Time (Qt.UTC), and converted to Qt.LocalTime.

name: day
description: Extracts the day from a date, or the number of days from an interval.

name: day_of_week
description: Returns the day of the week for a specified date or datetime. The returned value ranges from 0 to 6, where 0 corresponds to a Sunday and 6 to a Saturday.

name: epoch
description: Returns the interval in milliseconds between the unix epoch and a given date value.

name: get_timezone
description: Returns the timezone object associated with a datetime value.

name: hour
description: Extracts the hour part from a datetime or time, or the number of hours from an interval.

name: make_date
description: Creates a date value from year, month and day numbers.

name: make_datetime
syntax: make_datetime ( year , month , day , hour , minute , second )
description: Creates a datetime value from year, month, day, hour, minute and second numbers.

name: make_interval
syntax: make_interval ([ years:=0 ][, months:=0 ][, weeks:=0 ][, days:=0 ][, hours:=0 ][, minutes:=0 ][, seconds:=0 ])
description: Creates an interval value from year, month, weeks, days, hours, minute and seconds values.

name: make_time
description: Creates a time value from hour, minute and second numbers.

name: minute
description: Extracts the minutes part from a datetime or time, or the number of minutes from an interval.

name: month
description: Extracts the month part from a date, or the number of months from an interval.

name: now
description: Returns the current date and time. The function is static and will return consistent results while evaluating. The time returned is the time when the expression is prepared.

name: second
description: Extracts the seconds part from a datetime or time, or the number of seconds from an interval.

name: set_timezone
description: Sets the timezone object associated with a datetime value, without changing the date or time components. This function can be used to replace the timezone for a datetime.

name: timezone_from_id
description: Creates a timezone object from a string ID (from the IANA timezone database). The ID must be one of the available system IDs or a valid UTC-with-offset ID.

name: timezone_id
description: Returns the ID string for a timezone object, using IDs from the IANA timezone database.

name: week
description: Extracts the week number from a date, or the number of weeks from an interval.

name: year
description: Extracts the year part from a date, or the number of years from an interval.

name: base_file_name
description: Returns the base name of the file without the directory or file suffix.

name: exif
description: Retrieves exif tag values from an image file.

name: file_exists
description: Returns TRUE if a file path exists.

name: file_name
description: Returns the name of a file (including the file extension), excluding the directory.

name: file_path
description: Returns the directory component of a file path. This does not include the file name.

name: file_size
description: Returns the size (in bytes) of a file.

name: file_suffix
description: Returns the file suffix (extension) from a file path.

name: is_directory
description: Returns TRUE if a path corresponds to a directory.

name: is_file
description: Returns TRUE if a path corresponds to a file.

name: current_parent_value
description: Only usable in an embedded form context, this function returns the current, unsaved value of a field in the parent form currently being edited. This will differ from the parent feature's actual attribute values for features which are currently being edited or have not yet been added to a parent layer. When used in a value-relation widget filter expression, this function should be wrapped into a 'coalesce()' that can retrieve the actual parent feature from the layer when the form is not used in an embedded context.

name: current_value
description: Returns the current, unsaved value of a field in the form or table row currently being edited. This will differ from the feature's actual attribute values for features which are currently being edited or have not yet been added to a layer.

name: hamming_distance
description: Returns the Hamming distance between two strings. This equates to the number of characters at corresponding positions within the input strings where the characters are different. The input strings must be the same length, and the comparison is case-sensitive.

name: levenshtein
description: Returns the Levenshtein edit distance between two strings. This equates to the minimum number of character edits (insertions, deletions or substitutions) required to change one string to another. The Levenshtein distance is a measure of the similarity between two strings. Smaller distances mean the strings are more similar, and larger distances indicate more different strings. The distance is case sensitive.

name: longest_common_substring
description: Returns the longest common substring between two strings. This substring is the longest string that is a substring of the two input strings. For example, the longest common substring of "ABABC" and "BABCA" is "BABC". The substring is case sensitive.

name: soundex
description: Returns the Soundex representation of a string. Soundex is a phonetic matching algorithm, so strings with similar sounds should be represented by the same Soundex code.

name: env
description: Gets an environment variable and returns its content as a string. If the variable is not found, NULL will be returned. This is handy to inject system specific configuration like drive letters or path prefixes. Definition of environment variables depends on the operating system, please check with your system administrator or the operating system documentation how this can be set.

name: eval
description: Evaluates an expression which is passed in a string. Useful to expand dynamic parameters passed as context variables or fields.

name: eval_template
description: Evaluates a template which is passed in a string. Useful to expand dynamic parameters passed as context variables or fields.

name: is_layer_visible
description: Returns TRUE if a specified layer is visible.

name: mime_type
description: Returns the mime type of the binary data.

name: var
description: Returns the value stored within a specified variable.

name: with_variable
description: This function sets a variable for any expression code that will be provided as 3rd argument. This is only useful for complicated expressions, where the same calculated value needs to be used in different places.

name: $area
description: Returns the area of the current feature. The area calculated by this function respects both the current project's ellipsoid setting and area unit settings. For example, if an ellipsoid has been set for the project then the calculated area will be ellipsoidal, and if no ellipsoid is set then the calculated area will be planimetric.

name: $geometry
description: Returns the geometry of the current feature. Can be used for processing with other functions. WARNING: This function is deprecated. It is recommended to use the replacement @geometry variable instead.

name: $length
description: Returns the length of a linestring. If you need the length of a border of a polygon, use $perimeter instead. The length calculated by this function respects both the current project's ellipsoid setting and distance unit settings. For example, if an ellipsoid has been set for the project then the calculated length will be ellipsoidal, and if no ellipsoid is set then the calculated length will be planimetric.

name: $perimeter
description: Returns the perimeter length of the current feature. The perimeter calculated by this function respects both the current project's ellipsoid setting and distance unit settings. For example, if an ellipsoid has been set for the project then the calculated perimeter will be ellipsoidal, and if no ellipsoid is set then the calculated perimeter will be planimetric.

name: $x
description: Returns the x coordinate of the current point feature. If the feature is a multipoint feature, then the x-coordinate of the first point will be returned. WARNING: This function is deprecated. It is recommended to use the replacement x() function with @geometry variable instead.

name: $x_at
description: Retrieves a x coordinate of the current feature's geometry. WARNING: This function is deprecated. It is recommended to use the replacement x_at function with @geometry variable instead.

name: $y
description: Returns the y coordinate of the current point feature. If the feature is a multipoint feature, then the y-coordinate of the first point will be returned. WARNING: This function is deprecated. It is recommended to use the replacement y() function with @geometry variable instead.

name: $y_at
description: Retrieves a y coordinate of the current feature's geometry. WARNING: This function is deprecated. It is recommended to use the replacement y_at function with @geometry variable instead.

name: $z
description: Returns the z value of the current point feature if it is 3D. If the feature is a multipoint feature, then the z value of the first point will be returned. WARNING: This function is deprecated. It is recommended to use the replacement z() function with @geometry variable instead.

name: affine_transform
syntax: affine_transform ( geometry , delta_x , delta_y , rotation_z , scale_x , scale_y [, delta_z:=0 ][, delta_m:=0 ][, scale_z:=1 ][, scale_m:=1 ])
description: Returns the geometry after an affine transformation. Calculations are in the Spatial Reference System of this geometry. The operations are performed in a scale, rotation, translation order. If there is a Z or M offset but the coordinate is not present in the geometry, it will be added.

name: angle_at_vertex
description: Returns the bisector angle (average angle) to the geometry for a specified vertex on a linestring geometry. Angles are in degrees clockwise from north.

name: apply_dash_pattern
syntax: apply_dash_pattern ( geometry , pattern [, start_rule:='no_rule' ][, end_rule:='no_rule' ][, adjustment:='both' ][, pattern_offset:=0 ])
description: Applies a dash pattern to a geometry, returning a MultiLineString geometry which is the input geometry stroked along each line/ring with the specified pattern.

name: area
description: Returns the area of a geometry polygon object. Calculations are always planimetric in the Spatial Reference System (SRS) of this geometry, and the units of the returned area will match the units for the SRS. This differs from the calculations performed by the $area function, which will perform ellipsoidal calculations based on the project's ellipsoid and area unit settings.

name: azimuth
description: Returns the north-based azimuth as the angle in radians measured clockwise from the vertical on point1 to point2.

name: bearing
description: Returns the north-based bearing as the angle in radians measured clockwise on the ellipsoid from the vertical on point1 to point2.

name: boundary
description: Returns the closure of the combinatorial boundary of the geometry (ie the topological boundary of the geometry). For instance, a polygon geometry will have a boundary consisting of the linestrings for each ring in the polygon. Some geometry types do not have a defined boundary, e.g., points or geometry collections, and will return NULL.

name: bounds
description: Returns a geometry which represents the bounding box of an input geometry. Calculations are in the Spatial Reference System of this geometry.

name: bounds_height
description: Returns the height of the bounding box of a geometry. Calculations are in the Spatial Reference System of this geometry.

name: bounds_width
description: Returns the width of the bounding box of a geometry. Calculations are in the Spatial Reference System of this geometry.

name: buffer
syntax: buffer ( geometry , distance [, segments:=8 ][, cap:='round' ][, join:='round' ][, miter_limit:=2 ])
description: Returns a geometry that represents all points whose distance from this geometry is less than or equal to distance. Calculations are in the Spatial Reference System of this geometry.

name: buffer_by_m
description: Creates a buffer along a line geometry where the buffer diameter varies according to the m-values at the line vertices.

name: centroid
description: Returns the geometric center of a geometry.

name: close_line
description: Returns a closed line string of the input line string by appending the first point to the end of the line, if it is not already closed. If the geometry is not a line string or multi line string then the result will be NULL.

name: closest_point
description: Returns the point on geometry1 that is closest to geometry2.

name: collect_geometries
description: Collects a set of geometries into a multi-part geometry object.

name: combine
description: Returns the combination of two geometries.

name: concave_hull
description: Returns a possibly concave polygon that contains all the points in the geometry

name: contains
description: Tests whether a geometry contains another. Returns TRUE if and only if no points of geometry2 lie in the exterior of geometry1, and at least one point of the interior of geometry2 lies in the interior of geometry1.

name: convex_hull
description: Returns the convex hull of a geometry. It represents the minimum convex geometry that encloses all geometries within the set.

name: crosses
description: Tests whether a geometry crosses another. Returns TRUE if the supplied geometries have some, but not all, interior points in common.

name: densify_by_count
description: Takes a polygon or line layer geometry and generates a new one in which the geometries have a larger number of vertices than the original one.

name: densify_by_distance
description: Takes a polygon or line layer geometry and generates a new one in which the geometries are densified by adding additional vertices on edges that have a maximum distance of the specified interval distance.

name: difference
description: Returns a geometry that represents that part of geometry1 that does not intersect with geometry2.

name: disjoint
description: Tests whether geometries do not spatially intersect. Returns TRUE if the geometries do not share any space together.

name: distance
description: Returns the minimum distance (based on spatial reference) between two geometries in projected units.

name: distance_to_vertex
description: Returns the distance along the geometry to a specified vertex.

name: end_point
description: Returns the last node from a geometry.

name: equals
description: Alias for 'equals_exact' function with default geometry backend QGIS. Tests whether two geometries are point-by-point exactly equal. Note that the order of their vertices matters. Returns TRUE if geometry1 is exactly equal to geometry2.

name: equals_exact
description: Tests whether two geometries are point-by-point exactly equal. Note that the order of their vertices matters. Returns TRUE if geometry1 is exactly equal to geometry2.

name: equals_fuzzy
description: Tests whether two geometries are point-by-point equal in respect of a tolerance. Note that the order of their vertices matters. Returns TRUE if geometry1 is fuzzy equal to geometry2.

name: equals_topological
description: Tests whether two geometries are topologically equal. Returns TRUE if geometry1 is topologically equal to geometry2, i.e. opposite data direction and duplicated data are valid.

name: exif_geotag
description: Creates a point geometry from the exif geotags of an image file.

name: extend
description: Extends the start and end of a linestring geometry by a specified amount. Lines are extended using the bearing of the first and last segment in the line. For a multilinestring, all the parts are extended. Distances are in the Spatial Reference System of this geometry.

name: exterior_ring
description: Returns a line string representing the exterior ring of a polygon geometry. If the geometry is not a polygon then the result will be NULL.

name: extrude
description: Returns an extruded version of the input (Multi-)Curve or (Multi-)Linestring geometry with an extension specified by x and y.

name: flip_coordinates
description: Returns a copy of the geometry with the x and y coordinates swapped. Useful for repairing geometries which have had their latitude and longitude values reversed.

name: force_polygon_ccw
description: Forces a geometry to respect the convention where exterior rings are counter-clockwise, interior rings are clockwise.

name: force_polygon_cw
description: Forces a geometry to respect the convention where exterior rings are clockwise, interior rings are counter-clockwise.

name: force_rhr
description: Forces a geometry to respect the Right-Hand-Rule, in which the area that is bounded by a polygon is to the right of the boundary. In particular, the exterior ring is oriented in a clockwise direction and the interior rings in a counter-clockwise direction. Due to the inconsistency in the definition of the Right-Hand-Rule in some contexts it is recommended to use the explicit force_polygon_cw function instead.

name: geom_from_gml
description: Returns a geometry from a GML representation of geometry.

name: geom_from_wkb
description: Returns a geometry created from a Well-Known Binary (WKB) representation.

name: geom_from_wkt
description: Returns a geometry created from a Well-Known Text (WKT) representation.

name: geom_to_wkb
description: Returns the Well-Known Binary (WKB) representation of a geometry

name: geom_to_wkt
description: Returns the Well-Known Text (WKT) representation of the geometry without SRID metadata.

name: geometry
description: Returns a feature's geometry.

name: geometry_n
description: Returns a specific geometry from a geometry collection, or NULL if the input geometry is not a collection. Also returns a part from a multipart geometry.

name: geometry_type
description: Returns a string value describing the type of a geometry (Point, Line or Polygon)

name: hausdorff_distance
description: Returns the Hausdorff distance between two geometries. This is basically a measure of how similar or dissimilar 2 geometries are, with a lower distance indicating more similar geometries. The function can be executed with an optional densify fraction argument. If not specified, an approximation to the standard Hausdorff distance is used. This approximation is exact or close enough for a large subset of useful cases. Examples of these are: computing distance between Linestrings that are roughly parallel to each other, and roughly equal in length. This occurs in matching linear networks. Testing similarity of geometries. If the default approximate provided by this method is insufficient, specify the optional densify fraction argument. Specifying this argument performs a segment densification before computing the discrete Hausdorff distance. The parameter sets the fraction by which to densify each segment. Each segment will be split into a number of equal-length subsegments, whose fraction of the total length is closest to the given fraction. Decreasing the densify fraction parameter will make the distance returned approach the true Hausdorff distance for the geometries.

name: inclination
description: Returns the inclination measured from the zenith (0) to the nadir (180) on point1 to point2.

name: interior_ring_n
description: Returns a specific interior ring from a polygon geometry, or NULL if the geometry is not a polygon.

name: intersection
description: Returns a geometry that represents the shared portion of two geometries.

name: intersects
description: Tests whether a geometry intersects another. Returns TRUE if the geometries spatially intersect (share any portion of space) and false if they do not.

name: intersects_bbox
description: Tests whether a geometry's bounding box overlaps another geometry's bounding box. Returns TRUE if the geometries spatially intersect the bounding box defined and false if they do not.

name: is_closed
description: Returns TRUE if a line string is closed (start and end points are coincident), or false if a line string is not closed. If the geometry is not a line string then the result will be NULL.

name: is_empty
description: Returns TRUE if a geometry is empty (without coordinates), false if the geometry is not empty and NULL if there is no geometry. See also is_empty_or_null.

name: is_empty_or_null
description: Returns TRUE if a geometry is NULL or empty (without coordinates) or false otherwise. This function is like the expression '@geometry IS NULL or is_empty(@geometry)'

name: is_multipart
description: Returns TRUE if the geometry is of Multi type.

name: is_valid
description: Returns TRUE if a geometry is valid; if it is well-formed in 2D according to the OGC rules.

name: length3D
description: Calculates the 3D length of a geometry line object. If the geometry is not a 3D line object, it returns its 2D length. Calculations are always planimetric in the Spatial Reference System (SRS) of this geometry, and the units of the returned length will match the units for the SRS. This differs from the calculations performed by the $length function, which will perform ellipsoidal calculations based on the project's ellipsoid and distance unit settings.

name: line_interpolate_angle
description: Returns the angle parallel to the geometry at a specified distance along a linestring geometry. Angles are in degrees clockwise from north.

name: line_interpolate_point
description: Returns the point interpolated by a specified distance along a linestring geometry.

name: line_interpolate_point_by_m
description: Returns the point interpolated by a matching M value along a linestring geometry.

name: line_locate_m
description: Returns the distance along a linestring corresponding to the first matching interpolated M value.

name: line_locate_point
description: Returns the distance along a linestring corresponding to the closest position the linestring comes to a specified point geometry.

name: line_merge
description: Returns a LineString or MultiLineString geometry, where any connected LineStrings from the input geometry have been merged into a single linestring. This function will return NULL if passed a geometry which is not a LineString/MultiLineString.

name: line_substring
description: Returns the portion of a line (or curve) geometry which falls between the specified start and end distances (measured from the beginning of the line). Z and M values are linearly interpolated from existing values.

name: m
description: Returns the m (measure) value of a point geometry.

name: m_at
description: Retrieves a m coordinate of the geometry, or NULL if the geometry has no m value.

name: m_max
description: Returns the maximum m (measure) value of a geometry.

name: m_min
description: Returns the minimum m (measure) value of a geometry.

name: main_angle
description: Returns the angle of the long axis (clockwise, in degrees from North) of the oriented minimal bounding rectangle, which completely covers the geometry.

name: make_circle
description: Creates a circular polygon.

name: make_ellipse
syntax: make_ellipse ( center , semi_major_axis , semi_minor_axis , azimuth [, segments:=36 ])
description: Creates an elliptical polygon.

name: make_line
description: Creates a line geometry from a series of point geometries.

name: make_point
description: Creates a point geometry from an x and y (and optional z and m) value.

name: make_point_m
description: Creates a point geometry from an x, y coordinate and m value.

name: make_polygon
description: Creates a polygon geometry from an outer ring and optional series of inner ring geometries.

name: make_rectangle_3points
description: Creates a rectangle from 3 points, the first two of which define its first side.

name: make_regular_polygon
description: Creates a regular polygon.

name: make_square
description: Creates a square from a diagonal.

name: make_triangle
description: Creates a triangle polygon.

name: make_valid
description: Returns a valid geometry or an empty geometry if the geometry could not be made valid.

name: minimal_circle
description: Returns the minimal enclosing circle of a geometry. It represents the minimum circle that encloses all geometries within the set.

name: nodes_to_points
description: Returns a multipoint geometry consisting of every node in the input geometry.

name: num_geometries
description: Returns the number of geometries in a geometry collection, or the number of parts in a multi-part geometry. The function returns NULL if the input geometry is not a collection.

name: num_interior_rings
description: Returns the number of interior rings in a polygon or geometry collection, or NULL if the input geometry is not a polygon or collection.

name: num_points
description: Returns the number of vertices in a geometry.

name: num_rings
description: Returns the number of rings (including exterior rings) in a polygon or geometry collection, or NULL if the input geometry is not a polygon or collection.

name: offset_curve
syntax: offset_curve ( geometry , distance [, segments:=8 ][, join:=1 ][, miter_limit:=2.0 ])
description: Returns a geometry formed by offsetting a linestring geometry to the side. Distances are in the Spatial Reference System of this geometry.

name: order_parts
description: Orders the parts of a MultiGeometry by a given criteria

name: oriented_bbox
description: Returns a geometry which represents the minimal oriented bounding box of an input geometry.

name: overlaps
description: Tests whether a geometry overlaps another. Returns TRUE if the geometries share space, are of the same dimension, but are not completely contained by each other.

name: overlay_contains
syntax: overlay_contains ( layer [, expression ][, filter ][, limit ][, cache:=false ])
description: Returns whether the current feature spatially contains at least one feature from a target layer, or returns an array of expression-based results for the features in the target layer contained in the current feature. Read more on the underlying GEOS "Contains" predicate, as described in PostGIS ST_Contains function.

name: overlay_crosses
syntax: overlay_crosses ( layer [, expression ][, filter ][, limit ][, cache:=false ])
description: Returns whether the current feature spatially crosses at least one feature from a target layer, or returns an array of expression-based results for the features in the target layer crossed by the current feature. Read more on the underlying GEOS "Crosses" predicate, as described in PostGIS ST_Crosses function.

name: overlay_disjoint
syntax: overlay_disjoint ( layer [, expression ][, filter ][, limit ][, cache:=false ])
description: Returns whether the current feature is spatially disjoint from all the features of a target layer, or returns an array of expression-based results for the features in the target layer that are disjoint from the current feature. Read more on the underlying GEOS "Disjoint" predicate, as described in PostGIS ST_Disjoint function.

name: overlay_equals
syntax: overlay_equals ( layer [, expression ][, filter ][, limit ][, cache:=false ])
description: Alias for 'overlay_equals_exact' function with default geometry backend QGIS. Returns whether the current feature's geometry is exactly equal to at least one feature's geometry from a target layer, or returns an array of expression-based results for the features in the target layer whose geometry is exactly equal to the current feature's geometry. Note that the order of vertices matters.

name: overlay_equals_exact
syntax: overlay_equals_exact ( layer [, expression ][, filter ][, limit ][, cache:=false ][, backend:='QGIS' ])
description: Returns whether the current feature's geometry is point-by-point exactly equal to at least one feature's geometry from a target layer, or returns an array of expression-based results for the features in the target layer whose geometry is exactly equal to the current feature's geometry. Note that the order of vertices matters.

name: overlay_equals_fuzzy
syntax: overlay_equals_fuzzy ( layer [, expression ][, filter ][, limit ][, cache:=false ][, backend:='QGIS' ][, epsilon:=1e-8 ])
description: Returns whether the current feature's geometry is point-by-point equal in respect of a tolerance to at least one feature's geometry from a target layer, or returns an array of expression-based results for the features in the target layer whose geometry is fuzzy equal to the current feature's geometry. Note that the order of vertices matters.

name: overlay_equals_topological
syntax: overlay_equals_topological ( layer [, expression ][, filter ][, limit ][, cache:=false ][, backend:='GEOS' ])
description: Returns whether the current feature's geometry is topologically equal to at least one feature's geometry from a target layer, or returns an array of expression-based results for the features in the target layer whose geometry is topologically equal to the current feature's geometry. See also 'equals_topological' function.

name: overlay_intersects
syntax: overlay_intersects ( layer [, expression ][, filter ][, limit ][, cache:=false ][, min_overlap ][, min_inscribed_circle_radius ][, return_details ][, sort_by_intersection_size ])
description: Returns whether the current feature spatially intersects at least one feature from a target layer, or returns an array of expression-based results for the features in the target layer intersected by the current feature. Read more on the underlying GEOS "Intersects" predicate, as described in PostGIS ST_Intersects function.

name: overlay_nearest
syntax: overlay_nearest ( layer [, expression ][, filter ][, limit:=1 ][, max_distance ][, cache:=false ])
description: Returns whether the current feature has feature(s) from a target layer within a given distance, or returns an array of expression-based results for the features in the target layer within a distance from the current feature. Note: This function can be slow and consume a lot of memory for large layers.

name: overlay_touches
syntax: overlay_touches ( layer [, expression ][, filter ][, limit ][, cache:=false ])
description: Returns whether the current feature spatially touches at least one feature from a target layer, or returns an array of expression-based results for the features in the target layer touched by the current feature. Read more on the underlying GEOS "Touches" predicate, as described in PostGIS ST_Touches function.

name: overlay_within
syntax: overlay_within ( layer [, expression ][, filter ][, limit ][, cache:=false ])
description: Returns whether the current feature is spatially within at least one feature from a target layer, or an array of expression-based results for the features in the target layer that contain the current feature. Read more on the underlying GEOS "Within" predicate, as described in PostGIS ST_Within function.

name: perimeter
description: Returns the perimeter of a geometry polygon object. Calculations are always planimetric in the Spatial Reference System (SRS) of this geometry, and the units of the returned perimeter will match the units for the SRS. This differs from the calculations performed by the $perimeter function, which will perform ellipsoidal calculations based on the project's ellipsoid and distance unit settings.

name: point_n
description: Returns a specific node from a geometry.

name: point_on_surface
description: Returns a point guaranteed to lie on the surface of a geometry.

name: pole_of_inaccessibility
description: Calculates the approximate pole of inaccessibility for a surface, which is the most distant internal point from the boundary of the surface. This function uses the 'polylabel' algorithm (Vladimir Agafonkin, 2016), which is an iterative approach guaranteed to find the true pole of inaccessibility within a specified tolerance. More precise tolerances require more iterations and will take longer to calculate.

name: project
description: Returns a point projected from a start point using a distance, a bearing (azimuth) and an elevation in radians.

name: relate
description: Tests the Dimensional Extended 9 Intersection Model (DE-9IM) representation of the relationship between two geometries.

name: rotate
description: Returns a rotated version of a geometry. Calculations are in the Spatial Reference System of this geometry.

name: roundness
description: Calculates how close a polygon shape is to a circle. The function returns 1 when the polygon shape is a perfect circle and 0 when it is completely flat.

name: scale
description: Returns a scaled version of a geometry. Calculations are in the Spatial Reference System of this geometry.

name: segments_to_lines
description: Returns a multi line geometry consisting of a line for every segment in the input geometry.

name: shared_paths
description: Returns a collection containing paths shared by the two input geometries. Those going in the same direction are in the first element of the collection, those going in the opposite direction are in the second element. The paths themselves are given in the direction of the first geometry.

name: shortest_line
description: Returns the shortest line joining geometry1 to geometry2. The resultant line will start at geometry1 and end at geometry2.

name: simplify
description: Simplifies a geometry by removing nodes using a distance based threshold (ie, the Douglas Peucker algorithm). The algorithm preserves large deviations in geometries and reduces the number of vertices in nearly straight segments.

name: simplify_vw
description: Simplifies a geometry by removing nodes using an area based threshold (ie, the Visvalingam-Whyatt algorithm). The algorithm removes vertices which create small areas in geometries, e.g., narrow spikes or nearly straight segments.

name: single_sided_buffer
syntax: single_sided_buffer ( geometry , distance [, segments:=8 ][, join:=1 ][, miter_limit:=2.0 ])
description: Returns a geometry formed by buffering out just one side of a linestring geometry. Distances are in the Spatial Reference System of this geometry.

name: sinuosity
description: Returns the sinuosity of a curve, which is the ratio of the curve length to the straight (2D) distance between its endpoints.

name: smooth
syntax: smooth ( geometry [, iterations:=1 ][, offset:=0.25 ][, min_length:=-1 ][, max_angle:=180 ])
description: Smooths a geometry by adding extra nodes which round off corners in the geometry. If input geometries contain Z or M values, these will also be smoothed and the output geometry will retain the same dimensionality as the input geometry.

name: square_wave
description: Constructs square/rectangular waves along the boundary of a geometry.

name: square_wave_randomized
syntax: square_wave_randomized ( geometry , min_wavelength , max_wavelength , min_amplitude , max_amplitude [, seed:=0 ])
description: Constructs randomized square/rectangular waves along the boundary of a geometry.

name: start_point
description: Returns the first node from a geometry.

name: straight_distance_2d
description: Returns the direct/euclidean distance between the first and last vertex of a geometry. The geometry must be a curve (circularstring, linestring).

name: sym_difference
description: Returns a geometry that represents the portions of two geometries that do not intersect.

name: tapered_buffer
description: Creates a buffer along a line geometry where the buffer diameter varies evenly over the length of the line.

name: touches
description: Tests whether a geometry touches another. Returns TRUE if the geometries have at least one point in common, but their interiors do not intersect.

name: transform
description: Returns the geometry transformed from a source CRS to a destination CRS.

name: translate
description: Returns a translated version of a geometry. Calculations are in the Spatial Reference System of this geometry.

name: triangular_wave
description: Constructs triangular waves along the boundary of a geometry.

name: triangular_wave_randomized
syntax: triangular_wave_randomized ( geometry , min_wavelength , max_wavelength , min_amplitude , max_amplitude [, seed:=0 ])
description: Constructs randomized triangular waves along the boundary of a geometry.

name: union
description: Returns a geometry that represents the point set union of the geometries.

name: wave
description: Constructs rounded (sine-like) waves along the boundary of a geometry.

name: wave_randomized
syntax: wave_randomized ( geometry , min_wavelength , max_wavelength , min_amplitude , max_amplitude [, seed:=0 ])
description: Constructs randomized curved (sine-like) waves along the boundary of a geometry.

name: wedge_buffer
syntax: wedge_buffer ( center , azimuth , width , outer_radius [, inner_radius:=0.0 ])
description: Returns a wedge shaped buffer originating from a point geometry.

name: within
description: Tests whether a geometry is within another. Returns TRUE if the geometry1 is completely within geometry2.

name: x
description: Returns the x coordinate of a point geometry, or the x coordinate of the centroid for a non-point geometry.

name: x_at
description: Retrieves a x coordinate of the geometry.

name: x_max
description: Returns the maximum x coordinate of a geometry. Calculations are in the spatial reference system of this geometry.

name: x_min
description: Returns the minimum x coordinate of a geometry. Calculations are in the spatial reference system of this geometry.

name: y
description: Returns the y coordinate of a point geometry, or the y coordinate of the centroid for a non-point geometry.

name: y_at
description: Retrieves a y coordinate of the geometry.

name: y_max
description: Returns the maximum y coordinate of a geometry. Calculations are in the spatial reference system of this geometry.

name: y_min
description: Returns the minimum y coordinate of a geometry. Calculations are in the spatial reference system of this geometry.

name: z
description: Returns the z coordinate of a point geometry, or NULL if the geometry has no z value.

name: z_at
description: Retrieves a z coordinate of the geometry, or NULL if the geometry has no z value.

name: z_max
description: Returns the maximum z coordinate of a geometry, or NULL if the geometry has no z value.

name: z_min
description: Returns the minimum z coordinate of a geometry, or NULL if the geometry has no z value.

name: item_variables
description: Returns a map of variables from a layout item inside this print layout.

name: map_credits
description: Returns a list of credit (usage rights) strings for the layers shown in a layout, or specific layout map item.

name: magnetic_declination
syntax: magnetic_declination ( model_name , date , latitude , longitude , height [, model_path ])
description: Returns the declination of a magnetic field at a point, in degrees east of north

name: magnetic_declination_rate_of_change
syntax: magnetic_declination_rate_of_change ( model_name , date , latitude , longitude , height [, model_path ])
description: Returns the rate of change of the declination of a magnetic field at a point, in degrees per year

name: magnetic_inclination
syntax: magnetic_inclination ( model_name , date , latitude , longitude , height [, model_path ])
description: Returns the inclination of a magnetic field at a point, in degrees down from horizontal

name: magnetic_inclination_rate_of_change
syntax: magnetic_inclination_rate_of_change ( model_name , date , latitude , longitude , height [, model_path ])
description: Returns the rate of change of the inclination of a magnetic field at a point, in degrees per year

name: decode_uri
description: Takes a layer and decodes the uri of the underlying data provider. It depends on the dataprovider, which data is available.

name: layer_property
description: Returns a matching layer property or metadata value.

name: load_layer
description: Loads a layer by source URI and provider name.

name: from_json
description: Loads a JSON formatted string.

name: hstore_to_map
description: Creates a map from a hstore-formatted string.

name: map
description: Returns a map containing all the keys and values passed as pair of parameters.

name: map_akeys
description: Returns all the keys of a map as an array.

name: map_avals
description: Returns all the values of a map as an array.

name: map_concat
description: Returns a map containing all the entries of the given maps. If two maps contain the same key, the value of the second map is taken.

name: map_delete
description: Returns a map with the given key and its corresponding value deleted.

name: map_exist
description: Returns TRUE if the given key exists in the map.

name: map_get
description: Returns the value of a map, given its key. Returns NULL if the key does not exist.

name: map_insert
description: Returns a map with an added key/value. If the key already exists, its value is overridden.

name: map_prefix_keys
description: Returns a map with all keys prefixed by a given string.

name: map_to_hstore
description: Merge map elements into a hstore-formatted string.

name: map_to_html_dl
description: Merge map elements into a HTML definition list string.

name: map_to_html_table
description: Merge map elements into a HTML table string.

name: to_json
description: Create a JSON formatted string from a map, array or other value.

name: url_encode
description: Returns an URL encoded string from a map. Transforms all characters in their properly-encoded form producing a fully-compliant query string. Note that the plus sign '+' is not converted.
example: url_encode(map('a&+b', 'a and plus b', 'a=b', 'a equals b'))

name: abs
description: Returns the absolute value of a number.

name: acos
description: Returns the inverse cosine of a value in radians.

name: asin
description: Returns the inverse sine of a value in radians.

name: atan
description: Returns the inverse tangent of a value in radians.

name: atan2
description: Returns the inverse tangent of dy/dx by using the signs of the two arguments to determine the quadrant of the result.

name: ceil
description: Rounds a number upwards.

name: clamp
description: Restricts an input value to a specified range.

name: cos
description: Returns cosine of an angle.

name: degrees
description: Converts from radians to degrees.

name: exp
description: Returns exponential of an value.

name: floor
description: Rounds a number downwards.

name: ln
description: Returns the natural logarithm of a value.

name: log
description: Returns the value of the logarithm of the passed value and base.

name: log10
description: Returns the value of the base 10 logarithm of the passed expression.

name: max
description: Returns the largest value in a set of values.

name: min
description: Returns the smallest value in a set of values.

name: pi
description: Returns value of pi for calculations.

name: radians
description: Converts from degrees to radians.

name: rand
description: Returns a random integer within the range specified by the minimum and maximum argument (inclusive). If a seed is provided, the returned will always be the same, depending on the seed.

name: randf
description: Returns a random float within the range specified by the minimum and maximum argument (inclusive). If a seed is provided, the returned will always be the same, depending on the seed.

name: round
description: Rounds a number to number of decimal places. The rounding is done to the nearest number. The ceil or floor functions can be used if rounding up or down is required.

name: scale_cubic_bezier
syntax: scale_cubic_bezier ( value , domain_min , domain_max , range_min , range_max , x1 , y1 , x2 , y2 )
description: Transforms a given value from an input domain to an output range using a cubic Bézier curve. This function can be used to ease values in or out of the specified output range using custom control points.

name: scale_exponential
syntax: scale_exponential ( value , domain_min , domain_max , range_min , range_max , exponent )
description: Transforms a given value from an input domain to an output range using an exponential curve. This function can be used to ease values in or out of the specified output range.

name: scale_linear
syntax: scale_linear ( value , domain_min , domain_max , range_min , range_max )
description: Transforms a given value from an input domain to an output range using linear interpolation.

name: scale_polynomial
syntax: scale_polynomial ( value , domain_min , domain_max , range_min , range_max , exponent )
description: Transforms a given value from an input domain to an output range using a polynomial curve. This function can be used to ease values in or out of the specified output range.

name: sin
description: Returns the sine of an angle.

name: sqrt
description: Returns square root of a value.

name: tan
description: Returns the tangent of an angle.

name: parameter
description: Returns the value of a processing algorithm input parameter.

name: raster_attributes
description: Returns a map with the fields names as keys and the raster attribute table values as values from the attribute table entry that matches the given raster value.

name: raster_statistic
description: Returns statistics from a raster layer.

name: raster_value
description: Returns the raster value found at the provided point.

name: $currentfeature
description: Returns the current feature being evaluated. This can be used with the 'attribute' function to evaluate attribute values from the current feature. WARNING: This function is deprecated. It is recommended to use the replacement @feature variable instead.

name: $id
description: Returns the feature id of the current row. WARNING: This function is deprecated. It is recommended to use the replacement @id variable instead.

name: attribute
description: Returns an attribute from a feature.

name: attributes
description: Returns a map containing all attributes from a feature, with field names as map keys.

name: display_expression
description: Returns the display expression for a given feature in a layer. The expression is evaluated by default. Can be used with zero, one or more arguments, see below for details.

name: feature_id
description: Returns a feature's unique ID, or NULL if the feature is not valid.

name: get_feature
description: Returns the first feature of a layer matching a given attribute value.

name: get_feature_by_id
description: Returns the feature with an id on a layer.

name: is_attribute_valid
description: Returns TRUE if a specific feature attribute meets all constraints.

name: is_feature_valid
description: Returns TRUE if a feature meets all field constraints.

name: is_selected
description: Returns TRUE if a feature is selected. Can be used with zero, one or two arguments, see below for details.

name: maptip
description: Returns the maptip for a given feature in a layer. The expression is evaluated by default. Can be used with zero, one or more arguments, see below for details.

name: num_selected
description: Returns the number of selected features on a given layer. By default works on the layer on which the expression is evaluated.

name: represent_attributes
description: Returns a map with the attribute names as keys and the configured representation values as values. The representation value for the attributes depends on the configured widget type for each attribute. Can be used with zero, one or more arguments, see below for details.

name: represent_value
description: Returns the configured representation value for a field value. It depends on the configured widget type. Often, this is useful for 'Value Map' widgets.

name: sqlite_fetch_and_increment
syntax: sqlite_fetch_and_increment ( database , table , id_field , filter_attribute , filter_value [, default_values ])
description: Manage autoincrementing values in sqlite databases. SQlite default values can only be applied on insert and not prefetched. This makes it impossible to acquire an incremented primary key via AUTO_INCREMENT before creating the row in the database. Sidenote: with postgres, this works via the option evaluate default values . When adding new features with relations, it is really nice to be able to already add children for a parent, while the parents form is still open and hence the parent feature uncommitted. To get around this limitation, this function can be used to manage sequence values in a separate table on sqlite based formats like gpkg. The sequence table will be filtered for a sequence id (filter_attribute and filter_value) and the current value of the id_field will be incremented by 1 and the incremented value returned. If additional columns require values to be specified, the default_values map can be used for this purpose. Note This function modifies the target sqlite table. It is intended for usage with default value configurations for attributes. When the database parameter is a layer and the layer is in transaction mode, the value will only be retrieved once during the lifetime of a transaction and cached and incremented. This makes it unsafe to work on the same database from several processes in parallel.

name: uuid
description: Generates a Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) for each row using the Qt QUuid::createUuid method.

name: sensor_data
description: Returns the last captured value (or values as a map for sensors which report multiple values) from a registered sensor.

name: ascii
description: Returns the unicode code associated with the first character of a string.

name: char
description: Returns the character associated with a unicode code.

name: concat
description: Concatenates several values to a single string. NULL values are converted to empty strings. Other values (like numbers) are converted to strings. See the || function for an alternative concatenation behavior.

name: concat_ws
description: Concatenates all but first arguments with separators into a single string. The first parameter is used as a separator. NULL arguments are ignored.

name: format
description: Format a string using supplied arguments.

name: format_date
description: Formats a date type or string into a custom string format. Uses Qt date/time format strings. See QDateTime::toString .

name: format_number
syntax: format_number ( number [, places:=0 ][, language ][, omit_group_separators:=false ][, trim_trailing_zeroes:=false ])
description: Returns a number formatted with the locale separator for thousands. By default the current QGIS user locale is used. Also truncates the decimal places to the number of supplied places.

name: left
description: Returns a substring that contains the n leftmost characters of the string.

name: length
description: Returns the number of characters in a string or the length of a geometry linestring.

name: lower
description: Converts a string to lower case letters.

name: lpad
description: Returns a string padded on the left to the specified width, using a fill character. If the target width is smaller than the string's length, the string is truncated. If the fill parameter is omitted, the function will default to a space character.

name: ltrim
description: Removes the longest string containing only the specified characters (a space by default) from the start of string.

name: regexp_replace
description: Returns a string with the supplied regular expression replaced.

name: regexp_substr
description: Returns the portion of a string which matches a supplied regular expression.

name: repeat
description: Repeats a string a specified number of times.

name: replace
description: Returns a string with the supplied string, array, or map of strings replaced.

name: reverse
description: Reverses the direction of a line string or reverses a string of text.

name: right
description: Returns a substring that contains the n rightmost characters of the string.

name: rpad
description: Returns a string padded on the right to the specified width, using a fill character. If the target width is smaller than the string's length, the string is truncated. If the fill parameter is omitted, the function will default to a space character.

name: rtrim
description: Removes the longest string containing only the specified characters (a space by default) from the end of string.

name: strpos
description: Return the first matching position of a substring within another string, or 0 if the substring is not found.

name: substr
description: Returns a part of a string.

name: substr_count
description: Counts the number of occurrences of a substring within a string. By default, the function counts non-overlapping occurrences (like in Python). If the third argument is set to true, the function counts overlapping occurrences (like in QT).

name: title
description: Converts all words of a string to title case (all words lower case with leading capital letter).

name: trim
description: Removes all leading and trailing whitespace (spaces, tabs, etc) from a string.

name: unaccent
description: Removes accents and other diacritical marks from a string, replacing accented characters with their unaccented ASCII equivalents. This function is compatible with PostgreSQL's unaccent() function and uses the same comprehensive mapping rules. The function handles: Diacritical marks (é→e, ñ→n, ü→u, etc.) Ligatures (Æ→AE, œ→oe, etc.) Special letters (ß→ss, ł→l, ð→d, etc.) Compatibility characters (℃→°C, ½→ 1/2, etc.) Cyrillic special characters (ё→е, Ё→Е) Full-width characters (＃→#, etc.) Common use cases include normalizing text for search operations, creating ASCII-safe identifiers or filenames from international text, and matching user input regardless of accent usage.

name: upper
description: Converts a string to upper case letters.

name: wordwrap
description: Returns a string wrapped to a maximum/minimum number of characters.
